description:
Your scheduled videos (future slots). list: the schedules. get_slot / update_slot_title / delete_slot: one slot of a schedule. cancel: cancels a whole schedule: unpublished slots are removed, but only slots whose generation never ran get their prepaid tokens back (a generating or ready slot keeps its charge, the GPU cost is spent); a post already publishing or published is not recalled; a cancelled video of a discounted batch gives back the discount the batch no longer earns.
Actions and their required fields: list (no required fields); cancel (scheduleId); get_slot (slotId); update_slot_title (slotId, title); delete_slot (slotId).

action.description: What to do: list | cancel | get_slot | update_slot_title | delete_slot. The description lists the fields each action needs.

scheduleId.description: The ID of the schedule to cancel. Unpublished slots (pending, generating, or ready) are removed. Only slots whose generation never ran get their prepaid tokens back — a generating or ready slot keeps its charge, because the GPU cost is already spent. A post already publishing or published is not recalled.

slotId.description: The slot ID (the slotId field from posts (action: list) or generate_video).

title.description: The new title text for the slot. Only a slot that has not started generating (status pending/awaiting) can be edited; published or mid-flight slots are rejected.

name: schedules
